name: mrscraper
description: Web scraping for developers: retrieve pages as HTML, Markdown, or screenshots, search Google, and check MrScraper account usage.

interface.longDescription:
MrScraper retrieves web pages and Google results for developers building datasets and data-processing workflows. Retrieve a specified URL as HTML, Markdown, a screenshot, or a combination; discover URLs through Google search; and check account usage and remaining tokens.

A MrScraper account and an OAuth connection are required. Page retrieval and search contact external websites through MrScraper. The plugin does not schedule recurring jobs or send notifications. Use third-party sources only where you have authorization and comply with their terms.
defaultPrompt: Fetch this page and summarize its contents.
Search Google for this topic and return the most relevant sources.
Take a screenshot of this page.
